arxiv-1703-06826.title: RatingScaleReduction package: stepwise rating scale item reduction without predictability loss
arxiv-1703-06826.creator: by Waldemar W. Koczkodaj, Alicja Wolny–Dominiak
arxiv-1703-06826.description: Abstract This study presents an innovative method for reducing the number of rating scale items without predictability loss. The “area under the receiver operator curve method” (AUC ROC) is used to implement in the RatingScaleReduction package posted on CRAN 1 1 1 https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/RatingScaleReduction/index.html .

arxiv-1811-12407.title: On the properties of spectral effect algebras
arxiv-1811-12407.creator: Anna Jenčová, Martin Plávala
arxiv-1811-12407.description: A 2018 arXiv research paper by Anna Jenčová, Martin Plávala. The aim of this paper is to show that there can be either only one or uncountably many contexts in any spectral effect algebra, answering a question posed in [S. Gudder, Convex and Sequential Effect Algebras, (2018), arXiv:1802.01265]. We also provide some results on the structure of spectral effect algebras and their state spaces and investigate the direct products and direct convex sums of spectral effect algebras.

arxiv-2108-04886.title: Differentiable Surface Rendering via Non-Differentiable Sampling
arxiv-2108-04886.creator: Forrester Cole, Kyle Genova, Avneesh Sud, Daniel Vlasic, Zhoutong Zhang
arxiv-2108-04886.description: Abstract We present a method for differentiable rendering of 3D surfaces that supports both explicit and implicit representations, provides derivatives at occlusion boundaries, and is fast and simple to implement. The method first samples the surface using non-differentiable rasterization, then applies differentiable, depth-aware point splatting to produce the final image.

arxiv-2209-02657.title: Characterizing parabolic hyperplanes of the hyperbolic and elliptic quadrics in PG ​ ( 2 ​ n + 1 , q ) \mbox{\rm PG}(2n+1,q)
arxiv-2209-02657.creator: Bikramaditya Sahu
arxiv-2209-02657.description: Abstract In this article, a combinatorial characterization of the family of parabolic hyperplanes of a hyperbolic (respectively, elliptic) quadric of PG ​ ( 2 ​ n + 1 , q ) \mbox{\rm PG}(2n+1,q) , using their intersection properties with the points and subspaces of codimension 2, is given.

arxiv-2212-05252.title: Some identities related to degenerate r r -Bell and degenerate Fubini polynomials
arxiv-2212-05252.creator: Taekyun Kim, Dae San Kim, Jongkyum Kwon
arxiv-2212-05252.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Taekyun Kim, Dae San Kim, Jongkyum Kwon. Many works have been done in recent years as to explorations for degenerate versions of some special polynomials and numbers, which began with the introduction of the degenerate Bernoulli and degenerate Euler polynomials by Carlitz. The aim of this paper is to study some properties, recurrence relations and identities related to the degenerate r r -Bell polynomials, the two variable degenerate Fubini polynomials and the degenerate r r -Stirling numbers of the second kind.

arxiv-2212-10481.title: Execution-Based Evaluation for Open-Domain Code Generation
arxiv-2212-10481.creator: Zhiruo Wang, Shuyan Zhou, Daniel Fried, Graham Neubig
arxiv-2212-10481.description: Abstract To extend the scope of coding queries to more realistic settings, we propose ODEX, the first O pen- D omain EX ecution-based natural language (NL) to Python code generation dataset. ODEX has 945 NL-Code pairs spanning 79 diverse libraries , along with 1,707 human-written test cases for execution.

arxiv-2301-04665.title: A DZ white dwarf with a 30 MG magnetic field 2023 A DZ white dwarf with a 30 MG magnetic field – 7
arxiv-2301-04665.creator: M. A. Hollands, S. Stopkowicz, M.-P. Kitsaras, F. Hampe, S. Blaschke, J.J. Hermes
arxiv-2301-04665.description: Abstract Magnetic white dwarfs with field strengths below 10 MG are easy to recognise since the Zeeman splitting of spectral lines appears proportional to the magnetic field strength. For fields ≳ 100 \gtrsim 100 MG, however, transition wavelengths become chaotic, requiring quantum-chemical predictions of wavelengths and oscillator strengths with a non-perturbative treatment of the magnetic field.

arxiv-2305-01792.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Natalia Maślany. We extend the existing results on surjective isometries of unit spheres in the Tsirelson space T ⁡ [ 1 2 , 𝒮 1 ] T\left[\frac{1}{2},\mathcal{S}_{1}\right] to the class T ⁡ [ θ , 𝒮 α ] T[\theta,\mathcal{S}_{\alpha}] for any integer θ − 1 ⩾ 2 \theta^{-1}\geqslant 2 and 1 ⩽ α < ω 1 1\leqslant\alpha<\omega_{1} , where 𝒮 α \mathcal{S}_{\alpha} denotes the Schreier family of order α \alpha .

arxiv-2306-12647.title: The twist-3 gluon contribution to Sivers asymmetry in J / ψ J/\psi production in semi-inclusive deep inelastic scattering
arxiv-2306-12647.creator: Longjie Chen, Hongxi Xing, Shinsuke Yoshida
arxiv-2306-12647.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Longjie Chen, Hongxi Xing, Shinsuke Yoshida. We carry out the first calculation for the twist-3 gluon contribution to the single transverse-spin asymmetry(SSA) in J / ψ J/\psi production in semi-inclusive deep inelastic scattering. Our result shows that the J / ψ J/\psi SSA is an ideal observable to pin down the C C -even type twist-3 gluon distribution that has a direct relationship with the gluon transverse-momentum-dependent distribution function.

arxiv-2306-14353.title: Propagation Measurements and Coverage Analysis for mmWave and Sub-THz Frequency Bands with Transparent Reflectors Thanks: This work has been supported in part by the National Science Foundation (NSF) through the award CNS-1916766 as well as the industry membership fees from the Broadband Wireless Ac
arxiv-2306-14353.creator: Ashwini P. Ganesh, Wahab Khawaja, Ozgur Ozdemir, İsmail Güvenç, Hiroyuki Nomoto, Yasuaki Ide
arxiv-2306-14353.description: Abstract The emerging 5G and future 6G technologies are envisioned to provide higher bandwidths and coverage using millimeter wave (mmWave) and sub-Terahertz (THz) frequency bands. The growing demand for higher data rates using these bands can be addressed by overcoming high path loss, especially for non-line-of-sight (NLOS) scenarios.

arxiv-2308-01894.title: Quantum Maps Between CPTP and HPTP
arxiv-2308-01894.creator: Ningping Cao, Maxwell Fitzsimmons, Zachary Mann, Rajesh Pereira, Raymond Laflamme
arxiv-2308-01894.description: Abstract For an open quantum system to evolve under CPTP maps, assumptions are made on the initial correlations between the system and the environment. Hermitian-preserving trace-preserving (HPTP) maps are considered as the local dynamic maps beyond CPTP. In this paper, we provide a succinct answer to the question of what physical maps are in the HPTP realm by two approaches.

arxiv-2401-02642.title: Signatures of room-temperature superconductivity emerging in two-dimensional domains within the new Bi / Pb \rm{Bi/Pb} -based ceramic cuprate superconductors at ambient pressure Journal: arXiv
arxiv-2401-02642.creator: S. Dzhumanov 1, D.D. Gulamova 2, Sh.S. Djumanov 3
arxiv-2401-02642.description: Abstract We predict the possibility of realizing room-temperature superconductivity in different two-dimensional (2D) domains within the ceramic high- T c T_{c} cuprate superconductors at ambient pressure and experimentally confirm this prediction of 2D room-temperature superconductivity in the newly derived Bi / Pb \rm{Bi/Pb} -based ceramic cuprate superconductors containing many grain boundaries, interfaces and multiplate blocks.

arxiv-2401-04598.title: Opinion dynamics on non-sparse networks with community structure
arxiv-2401-04598.creator: Panagiotis Andreou, Mariana Olvera-Cravioto
arxiv-2401-04598.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Panagiotis Andreou, Mariana Olvera-Cravioto. We study the evolution of opinions on a directed network with community structure. Individuals update their opinions synchronously based on a weighted average of their neighbors’ opinions, their own previous opinions, and external media signals. Our model is akin to the popular Friedkin-Johnsen model, and is able to incorporate factors such as stubbornness, confirmation bias, selective exposure, and multiple topics, which are believed to play an important role in the formation of opinions.

arxiv-2412-02578.title: Private Linear Regression with Differential Privacy and PAC Privacy
arxiv-2412-02578.creator: Hillary Yang
arxiv-2412-02578.description: Abstract Linear regression is a fundamental tool for statistical analysis, which has motivated the development of linear regression methods that satisfy provable privacy guarantees so that the learned model reveals little about any one data point used to construct it.

arxiv-2503-22478.title: Almost Bayesian: Dynamics of SGD Through Singular Learning Theory
arxiv-2503-22478.creator: Max Hennick, Stijn De Baerdemacker
arxiv-2503-22478.description: Abstract The nature of the relationship between Bayesian sampling and stochastic gradient descent in neural networks has been a long-standing open question in the theory of deep learning. We shed light on this question by modeling the long runtime behaviour of SGD as diffusion on porous media.

arxiv-2504-00099.title: Dynamical Phases of Higher Dimensional Floquet CFTs
arxiv-2504-00099.creator: Diptarka Das 1, Sumit R. Das 2, Arnab Kundu 3,4, Krishnendu Sengupta 5
arxiv-2504-00099.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Diptarka Das 1, Sumit R. Das 2, Arnab Kundu 3,4, Krishnendu Sengupta 5. This paper investigates the dynamical phases of Floquet Conformal Field Theories (CFTs) in space-time dimensions greater than two. Building upon our previous work [ 1 ] which introduced quaternionic representations for studying Floquet dynamics in higher-dimensional CFTs, we now explore more general square pulse drive protocols that go beyond a single S ​ U ​ ( 1 , 1 ) SU(1,1) subgroup.

arxiv-2508-04194.title: A background-free signal of jet-induced diffusion wake in quark-gluon plasma
arxiv-2508-04194.creator: Zhong Yang, Xin-Nian Wang
arxiv-2508-04194.description: Abstract Rapidity asymmetry of jet-hadron correlation has been proposed as a robust signal of dijet‐induced diffusion wake in quark-gluon plasma in high‐energy heavy-ion collisions. We generalize this observable to other jet configurations such as γ / Z 0 \gamma/Z^{0} -jets and propose a new method to compute the rapidity asymmetry that is free of background.

arxiv-2509-23286.title: A2D : Any-Order, Any-Step Safety Alignment for Diffusion Language Models
arxiv-2509-23286.creator: ​Wonje Jeung Sangyeon Yoon Yoonjun Cho, Dongjae Jeon Sangwoo Shin Hyesoo Hong Albert No
arxiv-2509-23286.description: Abstract Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) enable any-order generation, but this flexibility enlarges the attack surface: harmful spans may appear at arbitrary positions, and template-based prefilling attacks such as DIJA bypass response-level refusals. We introduce A2D ( Any-Order, Any-Step Defense ), a token-level alignment method that aligns dLLMs to emit an [EOS] refusal signal whenever harmful content arises.

pmc-10627929.creator: Kathleen P O’Hora, Charles H Schleifer, Carrie E Bearden
pmc-10627929.description: Purpose of ReviewTo summarize current literature available on sleep in 22q11.2 Deletion Syndrome (22q11.2DS; Velocardiofacial or DiGeorge Syndrome), a neurogenetic disorder caused by a hemizygous deletion in a genomic region critical for neurodevelopment. Due to the greatly increased risk of developmental psychiatric disorders (e.g., autism and schizophrenia) in 22q11.

pmc-10656569.title: Clinical efficacy of electroacupuncture-like magnetic therapy compared to conventional transcutaneous electrical nerve stimulation in individuals with carpal tunnel syndrome
pmc-10656569.creator: Sui-Foon Lo, Li-Wei Chou, Huynh Chung, Hsiu-Chen Lin
pmc-10656569.description: This study aimed to evaluate the clinical efficacy of an electroacupuncture-like magnetic therapy (ELMT) and conventional transcutaneous electrical nerve stimulation (TENS) in patients with carpal tunnel syndrome (CTS). A prospective randomized controlled trial in single-centre was conducted. Thirty-four CTS patients confirmed by electrodiagnostic study were randomized into TENS or ELMT group and completed a six-week treatment program.

pmc-10753389.title: Systems immunology spanning tumors, lymph nodes, and periphery
pmc-10753389.creator: Dimitrios N. Sidiropoulos, Won Jin Ho, Elizabeth M. Jaffee, Luciane T. Kagohara, Elana J. Fertig
pmc-10753389.description: SummaryThe immune system defines a complex network of tissues and cell types that orchestrate responses across the body in a dynamic manner. The local and systemic interactions between immune and cancer cells contribute to disease progression. Lymphocytes are activated in lymph nodes, traffic through the periphery, and impact cancer progression through their interactions with tumor cells.

pmc-11474676.title: Method to apply temporal graph analysis on electronic patient record data to explore healthcare professional–patient interaction intensity: a cohort study
pmc-11474676.creator: John Booth, Maria H Eriksson, Stephen D Marks, William A Bryant, Spiros Denaxas, Rebecca Pope, Neil J Sebire
pmc-11474676.description: AimInteractions between patients and healthcare professionals (HCP) during hospital admissions are complex and difficult to interrogate using traditional analysis of electronic patient record (EPR) data. The objective of this study was to determine the feasibility of applying temporal network analytics to EPR data, focusing on HCP–patient interactions over time.

pmc-11676496.title: Buruli ulcer in Australia: Evidence for a new endemic focus at Batemans Bay, New South Wales
pmc-11676496.creator: Mehrab E Hossain, Caitlin Keighley, Andrew H. Buultjens, Jessica L. Porter, Paul D. R. Johnson, Timothy P. Stinear, Maria Globan, Caroline J. Lavender, Jake A. Lacey, Norelle L. Sherry, Anton Forsyth, Mark Formby, Ian Marr
pmc-11676496.description: We describe two locally acquired cases of Mycobacterium ulcerans infection (Buruli ulcer) in the town of Batemans Bay on the east coast of New South Wales (NSW), Australia, 150 km north of Eden, the only other place in NSW where Buruli ulcer has likely been locally acquired.

pmc-12625055.title: Biomechanical effects of aligner trimline design and intrusion protocol on mandibular anterior teeth: a finite element study
pmc-12625055.creator: Rugan Su, Jun Sun, Song Li, Wei Wang
pmc-12625055.description: ObjectiveThis study employed finite element analysis to evaluate the biomechanical effects of different aligner trimline designs (scalloped vs. high trimline) and intrusion methods (sequential vs. simultaneous) during mandibular anterior teeth intrusion.MethodsA finite element analysis model was developed to evaluate stress distribution and displacement patterns. Two trimline designs (scalloped and high trimline) and two intrusion protocols (sequential and simultaneous) were compared.

pmc-13182175.title: How to co-create context-sensitive analyses of health service experiences: proposed guidelines for contextualist collaborative thematic analyses with co-researchers
pmc-13182175.creator: Nina K. H. Bahl, Morten Brodahl, Hilde E. Nafstad, Rolv M. Blakar
pmc-13182175.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). PurposeUser involvement is a prominent requirement in health services research across international health service contexts. However, current limitations with user-involved analytical approaches restrict researchers' sensitization to service users' contexts in analysis, with detrimental consequences for rigor and validity.

pmc-13300184.title: Ventricular fibrillation during lattice-tip radiofrequency ablation adjacent to ICD coils: a multicenter case series
pmc-13300184.creator: B Kovacs, C V Malyar, K Kneizeh, N Schaerli, V Spahiu, T Kueffer, A Haeberlin, L Roten, M Kuehne, H Puererfellner, S Yap, T Reichlin
pmc-13300184.description: BackgroundThe novel lattice-tip dual-energy ablation catheter enables both pulsed-field and high-power temperature-controlled radiofrequency (RF) ablation. While generally effective, unexpected ventricular fibrillation (VF) induction has recently been reported during RF ablation in patients with implantable cardioverter-defibrillators (ICD). The causative mechanism remains to be determined.

pmc-13355685.title: Implementation of a specialized inpatient HIV care model and in-hospital mortality in South Brazil: a before-after study
pmc-13355685.creator: Pedro M. Fonseca, Andressa Noal, Gisele O. Boff, Ana Elize Barin, Eduardo Teixeira, Frederico DC. Abbott, Christopher J. Hernandez, Irajane Albuquerque, Omar Sued, Nicole Reis, Freddy Perez
pmc-13355685.description: SummaryBackgroundAdvanced HIV disease (AHD) remains a major cause of hospitalization and mortality among people living with HIV (PLHIV). We evaluated the association between implementation of a structured specialist-led inpatient HIV care model and clinical outcomes among hospitalized PLHIV in southern Brazil.

pmc-13509857.creator: Sara Manganelli, Giulia Raimondi, Fabio Alivernini, James Dawe, Elisa Cavicchiolo

pmc-13679248.title: Sex differences in the association of uric acid to HDL-cholesterol ratio (UHR) with subclinical cardiovascular damage
pmc-13679248.creator: Mariangela Rubino, Angela Palummo, Mattia Massimino, Carolina Averta, Stefania Belviso, Asia Servello, Francesco Maria Brisinda, Alberto Cosenza, Angela Sciacqua, Maria Perticone, Francesco Perticone, Elettra Mancuso, Gaia Chiara Mannino, Francesco Andreozzi
pmc-13679248.description: BackgroundCardiovascular diseases remain the leading cause of global mortality, with risk increasing significantly in women post-menopause. Identifying accessible biomarkers for subclinical risk stratification is a clinical priority. The uric acid to HDL-cholesterol ratio (UHR) has emerged as a composite marker reflecting metabolic burden and reduced vascular protection.

uslaw-usc-t48-s2169.title: 48 U.S.C. § 2169 — Abstention
uslaw-usc-t48-s2169.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t48-s2169.description: United States Code, Title 48 (Territories And Insular Possessions); Chapter 20 (Puerto Rico Oversight, Management, And Economic Stability); Subchapter III (Adjustments Of Debts). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Nothing in this subchapter prevents a district court in the interests of justice from abstaining from hearing a particular proceeding arising in or related to a case under this subchapter.
